Monica / all,

Quick status (for the one-pager):
- Roadmap commitment: AT-RISK (resource contention + one remaining infra gating task). Current internal GA target: 2028-06-28 (was 2028-06-15).
- Top 3 delivery risks:
  1) Inference runtime perf at 10k qps for streaming paths — impact: launch SLA; owner: infra (I). Mitigation: ongoing kernel tuning and load test scheduled 5/25; preliminary fixes may recover ~30% p95; contingency: limited-release with reduced max-concurrency.
  2) KV cache consistency under multi-tenant burst loads — impact: correctness/regression risk; owner: Irene Choi. Mitigation: rollback plan and extended canary on Dedicated; additional cache validation added to E2E tests.
  3) Third-party dependency for SSO cert rotation window — impact: customer onboarding delay; owner: Lauren Bishop. Mitigation: pre-provisioned fallback cert + ops runbook.
- Perf/cost changes: expected marginal increase in peak infra spend (~8-12%) if we keep GA latency SLOs for BrightCo traffic; suggested negotiation: limited initial throughput tiers to soften cost.

Attached: draft launch-risk-register.xlsx (tabbed by risk area) and short notes for the QBR slide.
